title: What is Netflix’s share of TV viewing? (Q2 2026)

facts.fact: YouTube held 13.4% of total U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, the top individual streaming service, per Adwave's summary of Nielsen data.
Total streaming accounted for 47.6% of all U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, a record high, per Adwave's summary of Nielsen data.
facts.quote: 47.6% of all TV viewing, a record high

facts.fact: Cable accounted for 21.6% of U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, per Adwave's summary of Nielsen data.
Broadcast accounted for 19.9% of U.S. TV viewing in April 2026, below 20% for the first time, per Adwave's summary of Nielsen data.
Netflix's share of U.S. TV viewing ran closer to 9% in January 2026, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: Netflix ran closer to 9% back in January 2026

facts.fact: Nielsen's April 2026 Gauge report was released on June 25, 2026.
Netflix was up about 0.3 points in April 2026 versus April 2025, per Adwave's reading of Nielsen data.
facts.quote: Netflix was up about 0.3 points in April versus a year earlier

facts.fact: Nielsen delayed its March 2026 Gauge amid a dispute over new measurement methodology.
facts.quote: Nielsen delayed its March Gauge amid a dispute over new measurement methodology

facts.fact: Nielsen's recalibrated Gauge methodology is not expected until the fall, per Adwave.
facts.quote: the recalibrated version isn't expected until the fall

facts.fact: As of late July 2026, April 2026 is the last month Nielsen has fully reported, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: April is the last month Nielsen has fully reported as of late July 2026

facts.fact: Netflix's ad-supported tier reached more than 250 million monthly active viewers globally by its May 2026 upfront presentation, up from 190 million in late 2025, per TheWrap as cited by Adwave.
facts.quote: by its May 2026 upfront presentation, up from 190 million in late 2025

facts.fact: In countries where Netflix's ad plan is offered, more than 60% of new sign-ups choose the ad plan, per Adwave's summary.
facts.quote: more than 60% of new sign-ups now choose it

facts.fact: Netflix ended 2024 with more than 301 million paid memberships worldwide, its last officially reported count before it stopped disclosing quarterly subscriber numbers.
facts.quote: Netflix ended 2024 with more than 301 million paid memberships worldwide

facts.fact: Adwave states the minimum to start advertising on connected TV with Adwave is $50.
facts.quote: Minimum to start advertising on connected TV with Adwave
